# ovh_dedicated_cloud_user (Data Source)

Get information about a VMware on OVHcloud (dedicatedCloud/PCC) user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ovh_dedicated_cloud_user" "john" {
  service_name = "pcc-1-2-3-4"
  user_id      = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_name` (String) The internal name of your VMware on OVHcloud
- `user_id` (Number) Id of the user

### Read-Only

- `activation_state` (String) Activation state of the user account
- `can_manage_ip_fail_overs` (Boolean) Defines if the user can manage ip failovers
- `can_manage_network` (Boolean) Defines if the user can manage the network
- `can_manage_rights` (Boolean) Defines if the user can manage users rights
- `email` (String) Email address of the user
- `encryption_right` (Boolean) Defines if the user can manage encryption / KMS configuration
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user
- `full_admin_ro` (Boolean) Defines if the user is a full admin in readonly
- `identity_provider_id` (Number) Linked Identity Provider (if any), can be Federation Active Directory or IAM
- `identity_provider_type` (String) Linked Identity Provider type (if any), can be Federation Active Directory or IAM
- `is_enable_manageable` (Boolean) Check if the given VMware on OVHcloud user can be enabled or disabled
- `is_token_validator` (Boolean) Defines if the user can confirm security tokens (if a compatible option is enabled)
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user
- `login` (String) Login of the user
- `name` (String) Name of the user
- `nsx_right` (Boolean) Is this User able to access nsx interface (requires NSX option)
- `phone_number` (String) Mobile phone number of the user
- `receive_alerts` (Boolean) Defines if the user receives technical alerts
- `state` (String) State of the user account
- `type` (String) User type (if any)
